result.stderr:
Usage: beacon-doctor mcp <https://host/beacon/mcp> [--token-stdin] [--json]
The access token comes from the BEACON_MCP_TOKEN environment variable, or from standard input with --token-stdin.
The token is sent to that endpoint only. Without one, the sign-in path is checked but not the handshake.
